tagline: Providing essential water and wastewater services since 1897
hero_kpi_rationale: The Capex KPI is selected as the hero because it reflects strategic investment in resilience and regulatory compliance (PFAS, infrastructure), the primary driver of the company's regulated growth trajectory.

kpis.name: Capital Expenditures
kpis.explanation: Amount invested annually in water and wastewater infrastructure.
kpis.description: The construction program anticipates approximately $126 million in investments in 2026, primarily for PFAS compliance and network upgrades.
kpis.signal: Significant investment in modernization to meet PFAS standards

kpis.name: Middlesex System Contribution
kpis.explanation: Share of consolidated operating revenues generated by the core Middlesex system.
kpis.description: The Middlesex system generated approximately 67% of consolidated operating revenues in 2025, reflecting strong contribution from the core system.
kpis.signal: Strong contribution of the core system to consolidated revenues

kpis.name: Total Headcount
kpis.explanation: Total number of employees working for the company.

kpis.name: R&D Investments (% of revenue)
kpis.explanation: Research and development expenses relative to revenue.

kpis.name: Operating Margin
kpis.explanation: Operating profit divided by total revenues.

kpis.name: Regulated Revenue Mix
kpis.explanation: Proportion of total revenues derived from the regulated segment.
kpis.description: The regulated segment contributed approximately 94% of total revenues in 2025 and 93% in 2024.
kpis.signal: High stability of the regulated business model

kpis.name: PFAS Treatment Program
kpis.explanation: Capital investment to comply with federal and state PFAS regulations.
kpis.description: Between 2026 and 2028, approximately $255 million will be invested to upgrade the Carl J. Olson water treatment plant to implement PFAS treatment from source water.
kpis.signal: Major investment in PFAS regulatory compliance

kpis.name: Served Customer Base
kpis.explanation: Total number of retail customers served across all operating systems.
kpis.description: The company serves approximately 131,000 customers in its regulated utility systems, including 61,000 in the core Middlesex system and 65,000 in the Tidewater systems in Delaware.

kpis.name: Dividend Per Share
kpis.explanation: Montant total versé en dividendes par action sur l'année fiscale.

kpis.name: Capital Returned to Shareholders
kpis.explanation: Total annuel : dividendes versés + rachats d'actions.
kpis.description: Cumulative dividends + buybacks (2021-2025) in billions USD. Source yfinance cashflow.

kpis.name: Payout Ratio
kpis.explanation: Part du résultat net redistribuée. >80 % = potentiellement non soutenable.

risks.title: Water Supply Contamination
risks.score_rationale: This risk is mentioned multiple times in the text (Item 1A). The language used is strong, highlighting 'significant costs', 'reputational damage', and 'potential litigation'. Contamination could lead to service disruption and high remediation costs, directly impacting profitability.

risks.title: Regulatory Restrictions on Rates
risks.score_rationale: The text emphasizes revenue dependence on rates approved by public utility commissions (Item 1A). The language indicates that modifications, delays, or rejections by these agencies would 'limit revenue growth' and 'reduce profits'. The weighting is high because rate regulation is central to the business model.

risks.title: Climate Change Impact on Water
risks.score_rationale: Climate change is explicitly linked to weather volatility and its impacts on water availability and customer demand (Item 1A). The text mentions 'additional expenses' and 'uncertainty regarding financial impact'. This risk is increasingly relevant in the current context.

risks.title: Supply Chain Disruptions
risks.score_rationale: This risk is described as a current and future concern (Item 1A), affecting the procurement of essential goods such as pipes, chemicals, and energy. The language emphasizes the risk of not obtaining goods at a 'reasonable price or at all', impacting operations and compliance.

risks.title: Environmental Compliance Costs
risks.score_rationale: The text details numerous environmental regulations the company is subject to (Item 1A), as well as 'compliance costs' and risks of 'fines or other sanctions'. The possibility of not recovering these costs through rates is a key point.

risks.title: Access to Financing and Cost of Capital
risks.score_rationale: The company relies on financial markets to fund its investments (Item 1A), but access to and cost of capital are subject to regulatory approval. The text mentions the risk of not being able to 'obtain sufficient capital' or that 'the cost of capital may be too high'.

risks.title: Risks Related to Acquisitions and Contracts
risks.score_rationale: The acquisition of assets and management of operating contracts are presented as a growth strategy (Item 1A), but involve 'risks'. Obtaining regulatory approvals and managing contractual costs are critical points.

ai_positioning.summary: The company MSEX does not mention artificial intelligence or machine learning in its 10-K/20-F report.
